newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 373 bln lire of Italy CCT.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 373 bln lire of Italy CCT.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 373 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 7.242 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 1, 2004 paper, against 1.500 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.55 from 99.30 at the previous CCT sale on June 27.
